rationale: Residual positives are extremely under-represented if appended once, so they are repeated 8x.
Hard negatives are repeated 4x to preserve a strong guard rail without overpowering positive adaptation.
Validation is kept unchanged to preserve global model selection comparability.
Test removes the 12 injected rows to avoid direct train-test leakage in adaptation experiments.
caveats: This is an adaptation split derived partly from original core test samples, so original same-manifest core-test comparability is no longer valid.
Use the unchanged core validation for selection and the filtered adaptation test only as a non-leaky post-adaptation check.
